description: Pair the user's own wallet app (MetaMask, OKX, Trust, …) over WalletConnect, for gang_buy / gang_sell with wallet: "wc" only (everything else stays with the Agentic Wallet). Returns uri and qr (the uri as a text QR code) at once: show them to the user to scan and approve in the wallet, then call gang_wallet_status until connected: true. One wallet at a time, kept 24 h at most.

timeout.description: Seconds to wait for the approval (default 300)

name: gang_wallet_connect
title: Connect a wallet app
